eta.uncertainty: Section physics is an estimate, not measured segment speed; aggregate-history geometry is a proxy. Residual coverage does not validate new terrain, surface, wind or segment timing.

provenance.transformations: Spatial subsampling, time-window extrema and wind components by Section 11.

summary.aggregation: Extrema over section arrival windows; precipitation is not a ride total.

sampling.method: Nearest distance sample; headings retained per polyline leg.
sampling.limitations: Approximate 500 m geometry; no shelter, road safety or local exposure.
